# Attribution scope

The Headroom LICENSE and NOTICE are retained verbatim from the pinned upstream
source. This package adapts only Headroom's prefix classification approach in
`src/prefix-compare.ts`; it does not bundle or link the additional Headroom
components/dependencies described in the upstream NOTICE. Those upstream inventory
entries are not Rewind's dependency inventory. Rewind's package manifest and lock
file describe its installed dependencies.
